2 
3 The page discovers SKILL.md files without registering runners or changing the
4 Foundry map. Foundry owns content: per-skill LIBRARY.json / FLOW.json and
5 knowledge/graph.json, or library.json / process-map.json / knowledge-map.json
6 in FOUNDRY_PAGE_CONTENT_ROOT/<skill>. Nothing here writes to a skill repository.
7 Missing/invalid maps stay unfinished; geometry and frequency are never learned
8 or inferred by this display adapter.
9 """

66 def _inside(path, root):
67     try:
68         path.resolve().relative_to(root.resolve())
69         return True
70     except (OSError, ValueError):
71         return False

74 def _allowed(path):
75     roots = (*discovery_roots(), content_root())
76     return any(_inside(path, root) for root in roots)

79 def _frontmatter(text, field):
80     fm = re.match(r'^---\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n---', text)
81     if not fm:
82         return ''
83     m = re.search(r'^' + re.escape(field) + r':\s*(.*?)\s*$', fm[1], re.M)
84     return m[1].strip('"\'') if m else ''
85 
86 
87 def _section(text, heading):
88     m = re.search(r'^##[ \t]+' + re.escape(heading) + r'(?:[ \t]+[^\n]*)?\n([\s\S]*?)(?=^#{1,2}\s|\Z)',
89                   text, re.M | re.I)
90     return m[1].strip() if m else ''

93 def _icon(directory, text, skill_id):
94     edge = CODE_ROOT / 'foundry-gui/public/brand' / ('foundry-edge-' + skill_id + '.png')
95     if edge.is_file():
96         return '/brand/' + edge.name, None
97     icon = _frontmatter(text, 'icon')
98     candidates = [directory / icon] if icon else []
99     for folder in (directory / 'assets', directory / 'assets/icons'):
100         if folder.is_dir():
101             candidates.extend(sorted(folder.glob('icon.*')))
102     for path in candidates:
103         if _allowed(path) and path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() in ICON_TYPES:
104             return '/foundry/icon?' + urlencode({'skill': skill_id}), str(path.resolve())
105     for key, name in ICON_NAMES:
106         if _key(skill_id) == key and (CODE_ROOT / 'vendor/brand' / name).is_file():
107             return '/vendor/brand/' + name, None
108     return None, None

111 def catalog():
112     foundry, skills_root, trio, steward = discovery_roots()
113     manifest = {str(Path(api._resolve_source(e.get('source'))).resolve()): e
114                 for e in api._load_manifest() if e.get('source')}
115     candidates = list(skills_root.glob('*/SKILL.md'))
116     candidates.extend(trio / name / 'SKILL.md' for name in ('crucible', 'foreman', 'researchPrime'))
117     candidates.append(steward / 'SKILL.md')
118     candidates.extend(Path(p) / 'SKILL.md' for p in manifest)
119     rows, seen = [], set()
120     for path in candidates:
121         directory = path.parent.resolve()
122         if str(directory) in seen or not path.is_file() or not _allowed(path):
123             continue
124         seen.add(str(directory))
125         text = _text(path)
126         if directory.name.lower() == 'templates' or _frontmatter(text, 'foundry').lower() == 'false':
127             continue
128         # agy-dispatch and Figure-Designer are explicitly excluded in the design;
129         # canonical frontmatter still needs the Foundry-owned follow-up.
130         if _key(directory.name) in ('agydispatch', 'figuredesigner'):
131             continue
132         entry = manifest.get(str(directory), {})
133         skill_id = 'ecgberht' if directory == steward.resolve() else _key(directory.name)
134         human = api._parse_human_md(_text(directory / 'HUMAN.md'))
135         parsed = api._parse_skill_md(text)
136         name = _frontmatter(text, 'name') or entry.get('name') or directory.name
137         if _key(name) == skill_id:
138             name = DISPLAY_NAMES.get(skill_id, name)
139         north = (_text(directory / 'NORTH-STAR.md').strip() or _section(text, 'North Star') or
140                  _text(directory / 'VISION.md').strip())
141         purpose = human['oneSentence'] or parsed['description'] or api._first_paragraph(parsed['body'])
142         icon, icon_path = _icon(directory, text, skill_id)
143         rows.append({'id': skill_id, 'name': name, 'purpose': purpose,
144                      'northStar': north, 'source': str(directory), 'ref': entry.get('ref'),
145                      'status': entry.get('status'), 'inFoundryMap': bool(entry),
146                      'icon': icon, 'iconPath': icon_path, 'role': None,
147                      'walkthrough': 'unfinished'})
148     profile = anchor_settings.steward_profile()
149     steward_row = next((r for r in rows if r['id'] == 'ecgberht'), None)
150     if steward_row:
151         rows.remove(steward_row)
152         for role, label, art, purpose in (
153             ('project', profile['seal_name'], profile['seal'],
154              'Keep one effort’s dialogue, decisions and delivery coherent.'),
155             ('portfolio', profile['high_seat_name'], profile['high_seat'],
156              'Seat and coordinate initiatives across projects.'),
157             ('starchart', profile['campaign_name'], profile['campaign_icon'],
158              'Explore goals and foresight, then hand approved work to the portfolio steward.')):
159             rows.append({**steward_row, 'id': 'steward-' + role,
160                          'name': profile['label'] + '-' + label, 'role': role,
161                          'purpose': purpose, 'icon': '/brand/foundry-edge-ecgberhtportfolio.png'
162                          if role == 'portfolio' and profile['key'] == 'ecgberht' else '/vendor/brand/' + art, 'iconPath': None})
163     rows.sort(key=lambda r: r['name'].casefold())
164     return {'skills': rows, 'persona': profile['label'],
165             'walkthroughOrder': ['researchprime', 'gandalf', 'steward-project',
166                                  'steward-portfolio', 'steward-starchart'],
167             'contentRoot': str(content_root()), 'northStar': api.load_north_star()}

174 def _load_artifact(skill, names):
175     directory = Path(skill['source'])
176     role = skill.get('role')
177     searches = [(content_root() / skill['id'], names), (directory, names)]
178     if role:
179         searches = [(content_root() / skill['id'], names),
180                     (directory, tuple(name.replace('.json', '.' + role + '.json') for name in names)),
181                     (directory / 'knowledge' / role, names)]
182     for base, file_names in searches:
183         for name in file_names:
184             path = base / name
185             if not path.is_file() or not _allowed(path):
186                 continue
187             try:
188                 data = json.loads(_text(path))
189                 if not isinstance(data, (dict, list)):
190                     raise ValueError('expected an object or array')
191                 return data, path, None
192             except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
193                 return None, path, 'Unreadable content: ' + str(exc)
194     return None, None, None

197 def _path(raw, directory, artifact_dir=None):
198     if not raw or not isinstance(raw, str) or '\x00' in raw:
199         return None
200     raw = raw.replace('\\', '/')
201     path = Path(raw)
202     candidates = [path] if path.is_absolute() else [directory / path]
203     if not path.is_absolute():
204         if artifact_dir:
205             candidates.append(artifact_dir / path)
206         candidates.extend([Path(api.FOUNDRY_ROOT) / path, discovery_roots()[2] / path])
207     return next((p.resolve() for p in candidates if p.is_file() and _allowed(p)
208                  and p.suffix.lower() in TEXT_TYPES and not any(
209                      part.startswith('.') for part in p.relative_to(p.anchor).parts
210                      if part not in ('.agents', '.claude', '.codex'))), None)

213 def source_url(skill, path, anchor=''):

217 def _anchor_link(anchor, skill, artifact_dir, resources):
218     if isinstance(anchor, str):
219         anchor = {'path': anchor}
220     if not isinstance(anchor, dict):
221         return None
222     if anchor.get('type') in ('no-code', 'no-instruction'):
223         return {'label': anchor.get('type'), 'note': anchor.get('reason') or 'Not implemented on this path.'}
224     path = _path(anchor.get('path') or anchor.get('file'), Path(skill['source']), artifact_dir)
225     if not path:
226         return {'label': 'Source unavailable', 'problem': 'Missing or outside the declared source roots'}
227     at = str(anchor.get('symbol') or anchor.get('heading') or anchor.get('anchor') or anchor.get('line') or '')
228     content = _text(path)
229     problem = None
230     if at.isdigit() and not 1 <= int(at) <= len(content.splitlines()):
231         problem = 'Source changed: line no longer present'
232     elif at and not at.isdigit() and at not in content:
233         problem = 'Source changed: anchor no longer present'
234     expected = anchor.get('sha256') or anchor.get('hash')
235     if expected and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
236         problem = 'Source changed since this map was checked'
237     resource = _resource(skill, path, 'tools', path.name, anchor=at)
238     if not any(r['id'] == resource['id'] for r in resources):
239         resources.append(resource)
240     return {'label': path.name + (' · ' + at if at else ''), 'href': resource['href'],
241             'resourceId': resource['id'], 'problem': problem}

244 def _resource(skill, path, category, title, anchor='', resource_id=None):
245     return {'id': resource_id or hashlib.sha256((str(path) + '#' + anchor).encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
246             'title': title, 'category': category, 'path': str(path), 'anchor': anchor,
247             'href': source_url(skill['id'], path, anchor), 'frequency': 'Use not recorded'}

250 def _frequency(record, skill, artifact_dir):
251     """Only counts backed by distinct existing run records get a use label."""
252     evidence = record.get('useEvidence') or record.get('usage_evidence') or []
253     if not isinstance(evidence, list):
254         return 'Use not recorded'
255     paths = {_path(p.get('path') if isinstance(p, dict) else p,
256                    Path(skill['source']), artifact_dir) for p in evidence}
257     paths.discard(None)
258     run_ids = set()
259     for path in paths:
260         if path.suffix != '.json' or not any(p in ('journal', 'runs') for p in path.parts):
261             continue
262         try:
263             data = json.loads(_text(path))
264             # A journal file existing is not proof that this resource was used.
265             if (isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('run_id') and
266                     record.get('id') in data.get('resource_ids', [])):
267                 run_ids.add(str(data['run_id']))
268         except (ValueError, TypeError):
269             pass
270     return f'{len(run_ids)} recorded ' + ('use' if len(run_ids) == 1 else 'uses') if run_ids else 'Use not recorded'
271

273 def _combined_display(skill, resources):
274     """Foundry-owned foundry-skill-display/v1 handoff; canonical sources stay live.
275 
276     Snapshot HTML targets are never served as executable mockup pages. Anchors
277     resolve the declared original file, check its frozen hash, and open in the
278     same contained reader as ordinary Library resources.
279     """
280     data, path, error = _load_artifact(skill, ('maps.json',))
281     if data is None:
282         return None, [error] if error else []
283     if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get('schema') != 'foundry-skill-display/v1' or data.get('skill_id') != skill['id']:
284         return None, ['Unsupported or different-skill maps.json handoff']
285     for field in ('sources', 'anchors', 'resources'):
286         if not isinstance(data.get(field), list):
287             return None, [field + ' must be an array in maps.json']
288     for field, child in (('knowledge', 'nodes'), ('process', 'steps'), ('process', 'edges')):
289         if not isinstance(data.get(field), dict) or not isinstance(data[field].get(child), list):
290             return None, [field + '.' + child + ' must be an array in maps.json']
291     issues, links = [], {}
292     sources = {s.get('id'): s for s in data.get('sources', []) if isinstance(s, dict)}
293     for anchor in data.get('anchors', []):
294         if not isinstance(anchor, dict):
295             issues.append('Invalid source anchor')
296             continue
297         source = sources.get(anchor.get('source_id'), {})
298         spec = {'path': source.get('origin'), 'line': anchor.get('start'), 'sha256': source.get('sha256')}
299         link = _anchor_link(spec, skill, path.parent, resources)
300         if link and link.get('href'):
301             target = _path(source.get('origin'), Path(skill['source']), path.parent)
302             start, end = anchor.get('start'), anchor.get('end')
303             if isinstance(start, int) and isinstance(end, int) and 1 <= start <= end:
304                 excerpt = '\n'.join(_text(target).splitlines()[start - 1:end])
305                 if anchor.get('sha256') and hashlib.sha256(excerpt.encode()).hexdigest() != anchor['sha256']:
306                     link['problem'] = 'Source changed: anchored excerpt differs'
307             else:
308                 link['problem'] = 'Invalid source range'
309         if not link:
310             link = {'label': 'Source unavailable', 'problem': 'Missing original source'}
311         if link.get('problem'):
312             issues.append(link['problem'])
313         links[anchor.get('id')] = link
314     categories = {'Reusable material': 'material', 'References': 'references', 'Other skills': 'skills', 'Tools': 'tools'}
315     for row in data.get('resources', []):
316         if not isinstance(row, dict):
317             issues.append('Invalid Library resource')
318             continue
319         link = links.get(row.get('anchor_id'), {})
320         if not link.get('href'):
321             issues.append('Library target missing: ' + str(row.get('id')))
322             continue
323         backing = next((r for r in resources if r['id'] == link.get('resourceId')), {})
324         resources.append({**backing, 'id': row.get('id'), 'title': row.get('title'),
325                           'category': categories.get(row.get('category'), 'material'),
326                           'description': row.get('summary', ''), 'problem': link.get('problem'),
327                           'frequency': _frequency(row, skill, path.parent), 'library': True})
328     flow = data.get('process') if isinstance(data.get('process'), dict) else {}
329     steps = []
330     for row in flow.get('steps', []):
331         if not isinstance(row, dict):
332             issues.append('Invalid process step')
333             continue
334         aa = [links[a] for a in row.get('anchors', []) if a in links]
335         steps.append({**row, 'description': row.get('summary'), 'anchorLinks': aa,
336                       'codeLink': aa[0] if row.get('code_status') == 'anchored' and aa else
337                           {'label': 'instructions-only', 'note': 'Session work; no code on this path.'},
338                       'instructionLink': aa[-1] if row.get('instruction_status') == 'anchored' and aa else
339                           {'label': 'no-separate-instruction', 'note': 'See the program source.'}})
340         if not aa:
341             issues.append('No process sources: ' + str(row.get('id')))
342     knowledge = data.get('knowledge') if isinstance(data.get('knowledge'), dict) else {}
343     nodes = [{**n, 'name': n.get('title'), 'parent': n.get('parent_id')}
344              for n in knowledge.get('nodes', []) if isinstance(n, dict)]
345     disagreements = [{**d, 'sourceLinks': [links[a] for a in d.get('anchors', []) if a in links]}
346                      for d in flow.get('disagreements', []) if isinstance(d, dict)]
347     return {'source': str(path), 'qualification': data.get('refinement') or 'Walkthrough awaiting human review.',
348             'steps': steps, 'edges': [{**e, 'from': e.get('source'), 'to': e.get('target'),
349                                       'sourceLink': links.get(e.get('anchor_id'))}
350                                      for e in flow.get('edges', []) if isinstance(e, dict)],
351             'exits': flow.get('terminals', []),
352             'disagreements': disagreements, 'nodes': nodes, 'issues': issues}, issues

355 def skill_detail(skill_id):
356     skill = find_skill(skill_id)
357     if not skill:
358         return None
359     directory = Path(skill['source'])
360     resources = []
361     for name in ('SKILL.md', 'HUMAN.md', 'NORTH-STAR.md', 'VISION.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', 'LESSONS.md'):
362         path = _path(name, directory)
363         if path:
364             resources.append(_resource(skill, path, 'material', name))
365     journals = sorted((directory / 'journal').glob('*.md'), reverse=True)
366     for path in journals:
367         if _path(str(path), directory):
368             resources.append(_resource(skill, path.resolve(), 'references', path.stem))
369     # Commands and links already declared by the skill open their actual files.
370     instructions = _text(directory / 'SKILL.md')
371     pattern = r'(?:[A-Za-z]:[/\\][^\s`"<>|)]+|(?:[\w.-]+[/\\])+[\w.-]+)\.(?:md|mjs|js|py|json|ts)'
372     for raw in dict.fromkeys(re.findall(pattern, instructions)):
373         path = _path(raw.rstrip('.,;'), directory)
374         if path and not any(r['path'] == str(path) for r in resources):
375             resources.append(_resource(skill, path, 'tools', path.name))
376     library, library_path, library_error = _load_artifact(skill, ('library.json', 'LIBRARY.json'))
377     artifact_dir = library_path.parent if library_path else directory
378     entries = library if isinstance(library, list) else (library or {}).get('resources', [])
379     issues = [library_error] if library_error else []
380     if not isinstance(entries, list):
381         entries = []
382         issues.append('Library resources must be an array')
383     for entry in entries:
384         if not isinstance(entry, dict):
385             issues.append('Invalid Library resource')
386             continue
387         category = entry.get('category') or entry.get('kind') or 'material'
388         title = entry.get('title') or entry.get('name') or entry.get('id') or 'Resource'
389         anchor = entry.get('anchor')
390         target = entry.get('path') or entry.get('file') or (anchor.get('path') if isinstance(anchor, dict) else None)
391         path = _path(target, directory, artifact_dir)
392         url = entry.get('url') or entry.get('href')
393         at = (anchor.get('symbol') or anchor.get('heading') or '') if isinstance(anchor, dict) else (anchor or '')
394         if path:
395             r = _resource(skill, path, category, title, str(at), entry.get('id'))
396         elif url and urlsplit(url).scheme in ('https', 'http') and urlsplit(url).netloc:
397             r = {'id': entry.get('id') or url, 'title': title, 'category': category,
398                  'href': url, 'external': True}
399         elif entry.get('skill') and find_skill(_key(entry['skill'])):
400             r = {'id': entry.get('id') or entry['skill'], 'title': title, 'category': 'skills',
401                  'href': '/foundry?' + urlencode({'skill': _key(entry['skill'])})}
402         else:
403             issues.append('Library target missing: ' + str(title))
404             continue
405         r['frequency'] = _frequency(entry, skill, artifact_dir)
406         r['library'] = True
407         r['description'] = entry.get('description') or entry.get('purpose') or ''
408         resources = [old for old in resources if old['id'] != r['id']]
409         resources.append(r)
410     # Composition is displayed from the existing map, never guessed from names.
411     manifest = next((e for e in api._load_manifest() if e.get('ref') == skill.get('ref')), {})
412     for edge in manifest.get('edges', []):
413         other = next((r for r in catalog()['skills'] if r.get('ref') == edge.get('to')), None)
414         if other:
415             resources.append({'id': 'skill-' + other['id'], 'title': other['name'], 'category': 'skills',
416                               'href': '/foundry?' + urlencode({'skill': other['id']}),
417                               'description': edge.get('type'), 'frequency': 'Use not recorded'})
418     combined, combined_issues = _combined_display(skill, resources)
419     issues.extend(combined_issues)
420     flow = _process_map(skill, resources, combined)
421     knowledge = _knowledge_map(skill, resources, combined)
422     human = _text(directory / 'HUMAN.md')
423     return {'skill': skill, 'resources': resources, 'libraryIssues': issues,
424             'libraryResources': [r for r in resources if r.get('library')] or
425                 [r for r in resources if r.get('category') != 'references'],
426             'librarySource': combined['source'] if combined else str(library_path) if library_path else None,
427             'processMap': flow, 'knowledgeMap': knowledge,
428             'howItWorks': _section(human, 'How it works') or 'Walkthrough not completed yet. Read the instructions below.',
429             'timeline': api._journal_events(str(directory)),
430             'capabilities': api._extract_section_details(api._parse_skill_md(instructions)['body']),
431             'journalCount': len(journals)}

434 def _process_map(skill, resources, combined=None):
435     if combined:
436         issues = list(combined['issues'])
437         issues.extend(_edge_issues(combined['steps'], combined['edges']))
438         return {**combined, 'status': 'needs checking' if issues else 'source-anchored draft', 'issues': issues}
439     data, path, error = _load_artifact(skill, ('process-map.json', 'FLOW.json'))
440     if not isinstance(data, dict):
441         return {'status': 'unfinished', 'issues': [error] if error else [], 'steps': [], 'exits': []}
442     steps = data.get('steps') or []
443     if not isinstance(steps, list):
444         return {'status': 'needs checking', 'issues': ['Process steps must be an array'], 'steps': [], 'exits': []}
445     if not steps:
446         for stage in data.get('stages', []):
447             for row in stage.get('steps', stage.get('rows', [])):
448                 steps.extend(row if isinstance(row, list) else row.get('boxes', [row]))
449     projected, issues = [], []
450     for index, step in enumerate(steps):
451         if not isinstance(step, dict):
452             issues.append('Invalid process step')
453             continue
454         anchors = step.get('anchors') if isinstance(step.get('anchors'), dict) else {}
455         code = _anchor_link(step.get('code') or anchors.get('code'), skill, path.parent, resources)
456         ins = _anchor_link(step.get('instructions') or step.get('instruction') or anchors.get('instructions'), skill, path.parent, resources)
457         if not code or not ins:
458             issues.append('Missing code/instruction declaration: ' + str(step.get('id', index)))
459         issues.extend(a['problem'] for a in (code, ins) if a and a.get('problem'))
460         projected.append({**step, 'id': step.get('id') or str(index),
461                           'title': step.get('title') or step.get('name') or step.get('t'),
462                           'kind': step.get('kind') or step.get('k') or 'program',
463                           'description': step.get('description') or step.get('summary') or step.get('d'),
464                           'codeLink': code, 'instructionLink': ins})
465     issues.extend(_edge_issues(projected, data.get('edges', [])))
466     return {'status': 'source-anchored draft' if not issues else 'needs checking',
467             'source': str(path), 'qualification': data.get('qualification') or 'Walkthrough awaiting human review.',
468             'steps': projected, 'edges': data.get('edges', []), 'exits': data.get('exits', []),
469             'swarm': data.get('swarm'), 'issues': issues,
470             'disagreements': data.get('disagreements', []), 'deliverable': data.get('deliverable') or data.get('outputs')}
471 
472 
473 def _edge_issues(steps, edges):
474     ids = [s.get('id') for s in steps]
475     issues = ['Duplicate process step IDs'] if len(ids) != len(set(ids)) else []
476     if not isinstance(edges, list):
477         return issues + ['Process edges must be an array']
478     for edge in edges:
479         if not isinstance(edge, dict) or edge.get('from') not in ids or edge.get('to') not in ids:
480             issues.append('Process edge has a missing step')
481     return issues
482 
483 
484 def _knowledge_map(skill, resources, combined=None):
485     data, path, error = ({'nodes': combined['nodes']}, Path(combined['source']), None) if combined else _load_artifact(skill, ('knowledge-map.json', 'knowledge/graph.json', 'graph.json'))
486     if not isinstance(data, dict):
487         return {'status': 'unfinished', 'issues': [error] if error else [], 'nodes': [],
488                 'qualification': 'Not drawn yet. No learned geometry or use frequency is available.'}
489     nodes = data.get('nodes') or []
490     if not isinstance(nodes, list):
491         return {'status': 'needs checking', 'issues': ['Knowledge nodes must be an array'], 'nodes': []}
492     projected, issues = [], []
493     by_id = {str(n.get('id')): n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, dict)}
494     if len(by_id) != len(nodes):
495         issues.append('Duplicate or invalid knowledge node IDs')
496     for node in nodes:
497         if not isinstance(node, dict):
498             issues.append('Invalid knowledge node')
499             continue
500         node_id = str(node.get('id'))
501         parents = node.get('parent_ids') or ([node['parent']] if node.get('parent') else [])
502         if not isinstance(parents, list):
503             parents = []
504             issues.append('Parent IDs must be an array: ' + node_id)
505         depth, seen, parent = 0, {node_id}, (parents[0] if parents else None)
506         if len(parents) > 1:
507             issues.append('Multiple parents: ' + node_id)
508         while parent:
509             if str(parent) in seen or str(parent) not in by_id:
510                 issues.append('Broken or cyclic hierarchy: ' + node_id)
511                 break
512             seen.add(str(parent))
513             depth += 1
514             ancestor = by_id[str(parent)]
515             pp = ancestor.get('parent_ids') or ([ancestor['parent']] if ancestor.get('parent') else [])
516             parent = pp[0] if pp else None
517         if node.get('ring') is not None and node['ring'] != depth:
518             issues.append('Ring disagrees with tree depth: ' + node_id)
519         resource_id = node.get('resourceId') or node.get('resource_id') or node.get('resource')
520         resource = next((r for r in resources if str(r['id']) == str(resource_id)), None)
521         link = None if resource else _anchor_link(node.get('anchor'), skill, path.parent, resources)
522         if link:
523             resource = next((r for r in resources if r['id'] == link.get('resourceId')), None)
524             if link.get('problem'):
525                 issues.append(link['problem'])
526         if not resource:
527             issues.append('No real Library target: ' + node_id)
528         elif resource.get('problem'):
529             issues.append(resource['problem'])
530         projected.append({**node, 'id': node_id, 'name': node.get('name') or node.get('title') or node_id,
531                           'parent': parents[0] if parents else None, 'depth': depth,
532                           'resourceId': resource['id'] if resource else None,
533                           'href': resource.get('href') if resource else None})
534     return {'status': 'seeded draft' if not issues else 'needs checking', 'source': str(path),
535             'qualification': 'Seeded declared hierarchy — not calibrated or learned geometry. Size does not represent use frequency.',
536             'nodes': projected, 'issues': issues}
537

539 def source_page(skill_id, requested, anchor=''):
540     """Exact allowlist of this skill's discovered Library/anchor resources."""
541     detail = skill_detail(skill_id)
542     if not detail:
543         return None
544     try:
545         requested_path = Path(requested).resolve()
546     except (OSError, ValueError):
547         return None
548     targets = {Path(r['path']).resolve() for r in detail['resources'] if r.get('path')}
549     if requested_path not in targets or not _allowed(requested_path):
550         return None
551     text = _text(requested_path)
552     lines = text.splitlines()
553     hit = (int(anchor) if str(anchor).isdigit() else
554            next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1) if anchor and anchor in line), 0))
555     esc = html.escape
556     rendered = '\n'.join('<span id="L%d" class="%s"><a href="#L%d">%d</a> %s</span>' %
557                          (i, 'hit' if i == hit else '', i, i, esc(line))
558                          for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1))
559     return '''<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8">
560 <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>%s — Foundry source</title>
561 <style>body{margin:0;background:#0f1117;color:#e2e4e9;font:15px/1.5 system-ui}header{padding:18px;border-bottom:1px solid #2e3340}a{color:#9ec0ff}pre{padding:18px;overflow:auto}pre span{display:block;min-height:1.5em}pre a{display:inline-block;width:4em;color:#8b8f9a}.hit{background:#3a2e17;outline:1px solid #e0a84a}h1{font-size:20px;margin:8px 0}.path{overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#8b8f9a}</style>
562 <header><a href="/foundry?skill=%s">← %s</a><h1>%s</h1><div class="path">%s</div><p>Read-only source%s</p></header>
563 <pre>%s</pre>%s</html>''' % (esc(requested_path.name), esc(skill_id), esc(detail['skill']['name']),
564                            esc(requested_path.name), esc(str(requested_path)),
565                            ' · anchor not found' if anchor and not hit else '', rendered,
566                            '<script>document.getElementById("L%d")?.scrollIntoView({block:"center"})</script>' % hit if hit else '')
567
